# Ecclesiastes Chapter 11 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 411v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ECC_011_page_001.jpg

---

**11:1** Send [shallach] your-bread [lachmekha] upon the-face [al-penei] of-the-waters [ha-mayim]; for in-many [be-rov] days [yamim] you-will-find-it [timtsa'ennu].

**11:9** Rejoice [semach], O-young-man [bachur], in-your-youth [be-yaldutekha], and-let-your-heart [libbekha] do-you-good [viytivekha] in-the-days of-your-youth; and-walk [ve-hallekh] in-the-ways of-your-heart [libbekha] and-in-the-sight of-your-eyes [einekha]; but-know [ve-da] that for-all these the-God will-bring-you [yevi'akha] into-judgment [ba-mishpat].

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "Cast your bread":** Often read as a proverb about generosity; it may also be commercial advice (send your goods by ship; the returns will come eventually). The ambiguity is characteristically Qoheleth.

*— EMET*
